subject.title: fix(streaming): preserve paragraph separators across block-streamed deliveries [AI-assisted]

question: Should the permanent block-streaming contract preserve paragraph boundaries with in-band text, explicit seam metadata, or an intentionally partial common-case repair?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and this PR is in the right shared area, but the near-maxChars case cannot be fully resolved by the current text-only approach without a maintainer choice about the delivery contract.

options.title: Require complete boundary semantics
options.body: Choose one candidate or replacement and require it to preserve paragraph boundaries across both in-budget and near-maxChars splits before merging.

options.title: Adopt explicit seam metadata
options.body: Ask the implementation to carry paragraph/newline/hard-split seam metadata through chunker, subscriber, and coalescer if text-only chunks cannot satisfy all invariants.

options.title: Accept a partial repair
options.body: Maintainers may knowingly land the common-case separator fix while leaving the exact near-limit boundary documented on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Require complete boundary semantics
recommendation.body: Choose one candidate or replacement and require it to preserve paragraph boundaries across both in-budget and near-maxChars splits before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history across coalescing, streaming docs, and chunking hardening, making it the best available owner for the contract choice.
